notes.schema: the schema of deployments/mainnet/busdc-mainnet.config.json. The block named `ethereum` describes the SOURCE vault, here on TRON: chainId 728126428 is what the TVM returns for block.chainid on TRON mainnet (the last 4 bytes of the genesis block id; chain parameter 71 is active), vault is the vault's 20-byte address (the T... address without its 0x41 prefix)
notes.tool: tools/deploy-pontes/deploy_pontes.py refuses ethereum.chainId != 1 on chain 700770 today (its line `mainnet policy: ethereum.chainId must be 1`). Deploying this token needs that policy widened to the decided source networks; it is one cross-area change for all round-16 bridges (agents/R16-CROSS-AREA.md). No contract changes
notes.limits: as bUSDC: supplyCap 100,000 (= the vault cap), bucket 10,000 per day (= the vault window), T = 0 (largeMintThreshold 0), 12 h delay, minBurn 70 (the vault takes a fixed 14 USDT from every release on TRON, computed from the measured cost of a release; the fee is at most 20% of the smallest burn)
notes.committee: the same 7 L2 mint keys (5 to mint, 6 to unpause or switch) and the same 3 L2 token guardians as bUSDC (coordinator decision, round 16)
